newsitem.title: USA: Property Capital raises special div estimate.
newsitem.headline: Property Capital raises special div estimate.

text.p: Property Capital Trust said Friday that that it has revised its estimate of special dividends to be paid from the sale of its remaining properties to between $6.80 and $7.30 per share.
The new estimate is before the payment of a $1.15 special dividend declared today, payable August 22 to shareholders of record August 11.
If achieved this will result in total special dividends, said the company, of between $12.75 and $13.25 per share, including today's special dividend.
The previous estimate was about $12 per share.
The company also declared a regular dividend of $0.06 per share today, payable on the same date as the special dividend.
Boston Property said that it projects that the bulk of its remaining propoerties will be sold within one year.
The company said the raised estimate is the result of the improved real estate market.
